user.title: Add an LPG cylinder
user.description: Gas Renew estimates how much gas is left from the days since you last changed the cylinder.

data_description.duration: How long a full cylinder usually lasts you. Auto-learn refines this every time you press Renew.
data_description.previous_change: If you know it, the gap between the two dates seeds auto-learn.

error.invalid_size: Enter a cylinder size between 1 and 100 kg.
error.future_date: The last change can't be in the future.
error.previous_after_last: The previous change must be before the last change.

data_description.m3_per_kg: About 0.54 for propane; butane-rich blends are lower. Changing this rescales the Energy dashboard total.
data_description.learn_samples: Duration becomes the average of this many most recent cylinders.

error.thresholds_order: Thresholds must go Critical < Low < Medium.

renew.name: Renew
renew.description: Mark that a fresh cylinder was fitted.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any Gas Renew entity of the cylinder.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it was changed. Defaults to today.
